ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90% low-intensity (black) pixels to 10% high-intensity (white) pixels, with white pixels primarily localized at the distal tips and as scattered punctate marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly solid black ventral surface with high-contrast white contiguous blobs located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, supplemented by sparse, small-diameter white mottling across the medial surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; the angle of the notch walls is approximately 40 degrees relative to the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely jagged boundary with high-frequency, varying-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge; notably higher amplitude peaks are visible on the right lobe medial edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edges tapering to acute distal points; trailing edge shows an overall concave sweep from tip to notch, interrupted by heavy serration.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of localized, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (0.5-2.0% of lobe area) distributed across the central dark region and near the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected, with heavy concentration and greater length on the left lobe and near the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring including both linear rake marks and circular punctate scars; possible minor tissue loss at the high-frequency serrated points of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip displays a significantly larger and more contiguous high-intensity white patch compared to the more fragmented white spotting on the left distal tip.
